description: Awarding the contract for laying of Distribution Mains and providing Service Connections for Kahatagasdigiliya, Horowpathana and Rambewa DS Divisions of the Anuradhapura North Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-06 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - With the objectives of providing safe potable water and increasing water supply coverage, the Anuradhapura North Water Supply Project - Phase - II is implemented using funds provided by the Japan International Cooperation Agency and the Government of Sri Lanka. It is expected to construct a water supply system covering 164 Grama Niladhari Divisions in the Divisional Secretariat Divisions of Padaviya, Kebithigollewa, Horowpathana, Kahatagasdigiliya, Rambewa and Medawachchiya in the Anuradhapura District, which rely on unsafe groundwater. The Cabinet granted approval on 30-03-2026 to award the contract for laying Distribution Mains and providing Service Connections for the Divisional Secretariat Divisions of Padaviya and Kebithigollewa under the said project. In addition, a contractor has been selected for the procurement of Distribution Mains and Service Connections for the Divisional Secretariat Divisions of Kahatagasdigiliya, Horowpathana and Rambewa in the year 2022 through the National Competitive Bidding Methodology. The proposal made by the Minister of Housing, Construction and Water Supply to award the said contract to M/s Maga Engineering (Pvt) Ltd., the substantially responsive lowest bidder, for a sum of 628.10 million Japanese Yen and 2,660.70 million Sri Lankan Rupees, based on the concurrence given by the Japan International Cooperation Agency to award the contract with the application of price escalation clauses to match the price level differences and the recommendation given by the Standing High Level Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.
